audit.whatIsWrong: The page states three times — level-6 spike, mid text and whys[4] — that Galio's landing knockup-taunt 'cancels his Slicing Maelstrom channel outright'. Slicing Maelstrom is not a channel.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Kennen summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions for magical damage.' There is no channel, no cast-time lock, and no channel flag on the ability in the kit file — only a zone flag. Kennen moves and fights freely while it ticks, so CC does not end it. Telling a Galio he can delete an enemy ultimate by landing his own is the kind of thing a player commits R on and dies for.
audit.corrected: Replaced with what actually happens: the knockup and taunt reposition him and pull the 550-radius storm off your team, and your amplified reduction eats the magic ticks. No cancel claim anywhere.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing explains how the Mark of the Storm stun is actually assembled, so 'don't get stunned' has no counterplay attached.
audit.why: Two facts do the work. Electrical Surge's active only damages and re-marks 'targets who are ALREADY marked' — with zero marks on you it does nothing. And Lightning Rush applies a Mark simply by passing through you, so his escape is also his mark-setter. Deny the first mark and the three-stack stun never assembles.
audit.corrected: Written into the early text, mid, wants.foe and the full layer's Key Ability Interactions and cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: Slicing Maelstrom is only ever referred to as something Galio's ult 'cancels', so Kennen's level-6 power spike has no stated size, and the full layer says 'Reassess his ultimate too'.
audit.why: Slicing Maelstrom is a FLAT 120 seconds at every rank, costs 0 energy, and strikes every enemy champion inside 550 repeatedly — the storm follows him rather than sitting where it was cast. So his 6 is a persistent teamfight aura, not a burst window, and one wasted ult costs him two full minutes. Galio meanwhile spikes at 6 as a map tool, not a duel tool, since Hero’s Entrance is 180s.
audit.corrected: Flat 120s and the 550 radius now stated at the level-6 spike, phases[4].why, the cooldown block, the late text and whys[6]; the level-6 comparison is now 180s global versus 120s local aura.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Lightning Rush' appears nine times with no cooldown, and Slicing Maelstrom has no number anywhere.
audit.why: Lightning Rush is 10/9/8/7/6 and costs 80 energy, the most expensive ability in his kit against Thundering Shuriken's 60. Slicing Maelstrom is a FLAT 120 seconds at every rank — it never shortens, so one baited ult buys you two minutes.
audit.corrected: 10s Lightning Rush, its 80-energy cost and the flat 120s ult now carried in the cooldown block, do's line, trading rules, Key Ability Interactions and the loading tip.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's level-1 why claims Galio 'wins most level-1 exchanges' while the content layer correctly concedes level 1 to Kennen, and both level charts read Kennen at levels 2-3 and both item stages while the prose calls those Galio's.
audit.why: Thundering Shuriken reaches 950 against Winds of War's 825, and Kennen pays energy rather than mana, so he can poke every 7 seconds at level 1 with no cost pressure. Galio does not win that. Conversely the content is right that 2-3 and the first tank-AP item favour Galio, because his whole kit is magic into an amplified reduction.
audit.corrected: Level-1 phase and breakdown.early rewritten to concede the level for the right reason. Chart rows left alone — 'Kennen' (6 chars) cannot become 'Galio' (5) inside the band. Flagged for the user.

audit.whatIsWrong: The loading tip ends with 'Anti-heal if he sustains'.
audit.why: Kennen has no heal anywhere in his kit. _missing-interactions.json instead flags this matchup for on-hit: Electrical Surge applies on-hit damage that scales with attack speed, and Lightning Rush grants attack speed on exit — so his damage is not purely burst and flat MR reads the trade wrong.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal line replaced with the mark-denial rule; the attack-speed-on-exit detail added to the foe-wants line.

edits.before: Level 1 is his — he has Thundering Shuriken (Q) and energy to spam it while you sit on a single ability with no dash to reach him, so just last-hit and eat the chip. The good news is his whole kit is magic, and the moment your spells land you flip it: at 2-3 you Q his step-up, hold the Shield of Durand channel so its magic-amplified reduction shrugs the shuriken, then release the taunt and Justice Punch through him. Only commit the E once Lightning Rush is down — that lightning-ball dash is the one thing that pulls him out of your taunt range.
edits.after: Level 1 is his — Thundering Shuriken reaches 950 to your 825 and he pays energy, not mana, so he can chip you every 7 seconds while you have one ability and no dash. Just last-hit and eat it. Deny the first Mark of the Storm though: Electrical Surge only damages targets that are ALREADY marked, and Lightning Rush marks you just by passing through, so with no mark on you his stun chain has nothing to build on. The lane flips at 2-3 — hold the Shield of Durand channel so the amplified reduction shrugs the shuriken, then taunt and punch, but only once his 10s Rush is spent.

edits.before: This is your lane. His Thundering Shuriken (Q) and Electrical Surge (W) zap just keep feeding Shield of Durand value, so trade into him whenever Lightning Rush is on cooldown — channel the W to soak the poke, release the taunt, Justice Punch the knockup, and drop Winds of War's center column on him. At 6 the lane stops being about him: Hero's Entrance lets you swing another lane that a kiting Kennen can't stop, and if he steps up to ult, your landing knockup-taunt cancels Slicing Maelstrom outright. Shove, look at the map, and roam.
edits.after: This is your lane. Thundering Shuriken and the Electrical Surge zap just feed Shield of Durand value, so trade whenever the 10s Lightning Rush is on cooldown — channel W to soak the poke, release the taunt, punch the knockup, drop the centre column. Watch the marks, not just the HP bars: his W only fires on an already-marked target, so a clean Galio is a Galio he cannot stun. At 6 the lane stops being about him — Hero's Entrance swings another lane a kiting Kennen can't reach, and his own R is a flat 120s.

edits.before: By two items you're not out-poking him — that was never the plan — you're the best teamfight button against him. Hold the Shield of Durand release and Hero's Entrance for the instant he commits Slicing Maelstrom into your carries: you eat the AoE stun on a magic-amplified shield and turn his flank into a free multi-man taunt. He out-scales as a backline flank threat if he gets fed, so don't duel him in a side lane — group, force the multi-man R, and let your team clean up while he's locked.
edits.after: By two items you're not out-poking him — you're the best teamfight button against him. Hold the Shield of Durand release and Hero's Entrance for the instant he commits Slicing Maelstrom into your carries: the storm keeps ticking whatever you do, but a knockup and a taunt drag him and his 550 radius away from them while your amplified reduction eats the magic. It is a flat 120s, so a wasted one costs him two minutes. Don't duel him in a side lane — group and force the multi-man taunt.

notes: Killed a false claim that appeared three times: the page said Galio's landing knockup-taunt 'cancels his Slicing Maelstrom channel outright'. Slicing Maelstrom is not a channel — Riot's text is 'Kennen summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions', he moves and fights freely while it ticks, and the kit file carries only a zone flag on it. A Galio who spends a 180s ultimate expecting to delete a 120s one loses the fight. Rewritten as what actually happens: the knockup and taunt drag him and the 550 radius off your carries. Best new mechanic: Electrical Surge's active only works on targets who are ALREADY marked, and Lightning Rush applies a Mark just by passing through you — so denying the first mark stops the three-stack stun from ever assembling, and that is now the tracked thing rather than a vague 'don't get stunned'. Also noted Kennen runs on Energy, and Lightning Rush is his most expensive ability at 80 against the shuriken's 60. I gave the costs rather than doing pool arithmetic, since the energy pool is not in the kit file. Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s at every rank. LEVEL-CHART CONTRADICTION for the user: chart reads Skill/Kennen/Kennen/Skill/Skill/Kennen/Kennen while diff is EVEN at 4/10 with the Final Rating line saying 'Favoured matchup' and the prose calling levels 2-3 and the first item Galio's.
